title: Neutron Measurement Physicist — Beam and Dosimetry Measurements
about: ASPL Fusion (Agnira Sanlayan Pvt. Ltd.) is an applied plasma and neutron-systems company working on accelerator-based BNCT, domestic medical-isotope production, and industrial neutron applications, within established Indian regulatory and safety frameworks. Our near-term proton-lithium (p-Li) accelerator is the engineering anchor of Phase 1: a clinical BNCT source by day, a particle neutron source for industrial NDE off-clinical-hours.
description: Plan and carry out the measurements that test ASPL's neutron-source and beam-shaping calculations: neutron yield and spectrum from the lithium target, beam quality at the treatment position, and dose in phantoms. The role builds the measurement programme from first benchmark experiments at host facilities through to commissioning measurements on ASPL's own beam.
responsibilities: Design the measurement campaign that validates ASPL's neutron-source and beam-shaping calculations, with a stated uncertainty budget for each quantity
Measure neutron yield, energy spectrum, and angular distribution from proton-lithium targets — activation foils, Bonner spheres, proton-recoil and time-of-flight methods
Characterise the therapy beam at the treatment position against the IAEA's recommended figures of merit for BNCT beams
Measure neutron and gamma dose components in phantoms — paired ionisation chambers, activation detectors, and passive dosimeters
Specify, procure, and calibrate detectors and beam monitors, with traceability to national standards
Compare measured results with Monte Carlo transport calculations (MCNP®, OpenMC, Geant4, PHITS) and feed the differences back into the design
Prepare measurement evidence for design reviews and for AERB licensing documentation
requirements: PhD in Experimental Nuclear Physics, Neutron Physics, or Radiation Metrology — or M.Sc./M.Tech. with equivalent research experience
3+ years of hands-on neutron measurements at an accelerator, reactor, or neutron-generator facility
Neutron spectrometry and activation analysis, including spectrum unfolding
Gamma spectroscopy with HPGe detectors, including efficiency calibration
Rigorous uncertainty analysis and clear written reporting of measured results
preferred: Experience with BNCT beam characterisation or epithermal neutron beams
Working knowledge of a Monte Carlo transport code for experiment design
Experience with dosimetry intercomparisons or a calibration laboratory
Publications in neutron measurement or dosimetry
benefits: Co-authorship on ASPL publications and patent filings (the default for technical roles)
Conference travel support (ANS, IEEE NPSS, IPAC, ASTRO, IAEA technical meetings and equivalent)
Direct mentorship from Prof. Prabhat Ranjan and Prof. Y.C. Saxena, plus weekly working-group technical syncs
Founding-team scope: shape your domain end-to-end as part of a small team scaling up
Core collaboration hours 10:00–18:00 IST with flexibility outside that window
